preamble: Backing of the alveolar trill [r] to the voiced velar fricative [ɣ]. It is documented in Austroasiatic: Proto-Pakanic *ɣ- comes from Pre-Pakanic *r-, and Hsiu notes that Proto-Palaungic *r- also became /ɣ-/ in many Angkuic languages.
sources: Hsiu, A. (2016). A preliminary reconstruction of Proto-Pakanic. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1127812
